Fourier zeros at n/w imply zero pushforward of the integral signed derivative endpoint measure to R/wZ; cumulative coefficients yield finite integer deconvolution g=1_[0,w]*nu. Equal intensity implies sum c=m and Bohr mean sum c^2=m; the nonnegative integer sum c(c-1)=0 forces all c=1. The correlation right derivative at zero determines the exact maximal interval count and forbids contacts, while finite Fourier-transform uniqueness gives D_B=D_A and the converse. Finite exact enumeration corroborates without proving the real-parameter result.

value.rationale: The motivated gap is exact phase retrieval for equal-width finite interval indicators against an unrestricted indicator competitor, despite known unrestricted 3-interval nonuniqueness. The theorem determines all ambiguity fibers and the invariance of width/count with no strong separation, giving a nontrivial global uniqueness theorem already for three intervals with arbitrarily small gaps. The positivity/integer endpoint factorization is a structural mechanism not equivalent to merely applying finite turnpike uniqueness.
